name: Beresheet
fact: First privately-funded lunar landing attempt — Israeli non-profit SpaceIL, 585 kg lander. Reached lunar orbit but a gyroscope failure during descent led to engine shutdown; when contact was lost about 150 m up, it was still moving at about 950 m/s horizontally and 134 m/s vertically. Carrying a 'lunar library' of human knowledge etched on nickel discs, plus a sample of tardigrades — extremophiles capable of cryptobiosis — that may or may not have survived the impact. Inspired Beresheet 2 (planned).
capability: Demonstrated that a small private team can reach the Moon.
